description: This file contains Redux action creators and data loaders related to content flagging in Mattermost, including fetching flagging status, configuration, flagged posts, channels, and teams, with support for batching and caching.

classes.name: ContentFlaggingChannelRequestIdentifier
classes.description: Type representing a request identifier for content flagging related to a specific channel and post.

classes.name: ContentFlaggingTeamRequestIdentifier
classes.description: Type representing a request identifier for content flagging related to a specific team and post.

methods.name: channelComparator
methods.description: Comparator function for ContentFlaggingChannelRequestIdentifier objects based on channelId.

methods.name: teamComparator
methods.description: Comparator function for ContentFlaggingTeamRequestIdentifier objects based on teamId.

methods.name: getTeamContentFlaggingStatus
methods.description: Fetches the content flagging status for a specific team.

methods.name: getContentFlaggingConfig
methods.description: Retrieves the content flagging configuration, optionally for a specific team.

methods.name: getPostContentFlaggingFields
methods.description: Fetches the content flagging fields for posts.

methods.name: loadPostContentFlaggingFields
methods.description: Loads post content flagging fields with batching support.

methods.name: getFlaggedPost
methods.description: Retrieves a specific flagged post by ID.

methods.name: loadFlaggedPost
methods.description: Loads a flagged post with batching support.

methods.name: getContentFlaggingChannel
methods.description: Fetches content flagging data for a specific channel and post.

methods.name: loadContentFlaggingChannel
methods.description: Loads content flagging data for a channel, with batching and caching.

methods.name: getContentFlaggingTeam
methods.description: Fetches content flagging data for a specific team and post.

methods.name: loadContentFlaggingTeam
methods.description: Loads content flagging data for a team, with batching and caching.

methods.name: getPostContentFlaggingValues
methods.description: Retrieves content flagging values for a specific post.
